title: ADR-001: .NET 8 (C#) + PostgreSQL over Java/Python for Core Services
content: ADR-001: Standardized on .NET 8 LTS (C# 12) with ASP.NET Core and PostgreSQL (Npgsql) for core business services. Rationale: 90% of internal engineering staff are senior C# developers, strong static typing reduces runtime defects, and Npgsql delivers top-tier throughput.

title: ADR-002: MassTransit + Azure Service Bus over Custom Queue Consumers
content: ADR-002: Selected MassTransit over Azure Service Bus for all asynchronous .NET workflows. Rationale: Built-in EF Core Transactional Outbox, automatic retry/dead-letter handling, and seamless local RabbitMQ testing via Testcontainers.
